subject: Perimeter discovery kickoff — RFI items & questionnaire
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Zhu <alice.zhu@medforge.com>, security@medforge.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0600
Subject: Perimeter discovery kickoff — RFI items & questionnaire

Hi Alice / MedForge security team —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a single checklist to move forward: 

- Scope: you’re evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for PHI-containing inference workloads (HIPAA) with a potential future air-gapped POC for high-risk sites.
- Compliance drivers: SOC 2 Type II in-progress (expected Q1 2027), GDPR data subject rights required for EU customers, HIPAA business associate requirements for US PHI.
- Network posture needs: network isolation between inference and customer apps, option to evaluate an air-gapped classifier for offline model updates, and diagram for your security team to validate NAT/firewall boundaries.

Requested next items from our side:
1) We’ll send a vendor security questionnaire template and a lightweight network-boundary diagram template you can fill in. Please return both within 7 business days if possible.
2) Please confirm current SOC 2 status (in-progress / gap areas) and share any evidence your team can provide or a point of contact for the SOC engagement.
3) Clarify if log retention or advanced audit logging beyond standard KMS/audit trails is required (we have add-on options).
4) Are there specific encryption-at-rest key management (customer-managed KMS / HSM) requirements?

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Template_v1.xlsx (questionnaire) + Network_Boundary_Template.svg (simple swimlane network diagram).

Proposed timeline: questionnaire + diagram back by Wed 2026-10-20 -> Redwood security review by Fri 2026-10-22 -> align on follow-up call week of 10/25.

If that works I’ll kick off the questionnaire now. Thanks again —

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alice Zhu <alice.zhu@medforge.com>

Cc: security@medforge.com
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 16:02:47 -0600
Subject: Re: Perimeter discovery kickoff — RFI items & questionnaire

Ben — thanks for the concise recap and for sending the templates. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: currently in the middle of a Type II readiness run; report expected in draft form late Jan 2027. We can share the SOC 2 scoping doc and the SOC auditor contact (see security@medforge.com).
- GDPR / HIPAA: we are contractually required to support GDPR DSARs and to handle PHI per BAA. Our legal team will want specifics on logging/audit retention and whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS.
- Air-gap: we are interested in a limited POC for an air-gapped inference appliance at one of our research sites; need to validate install footprint and patch/update flow.

We’ll take the questionnaire and the diagram template and start tabling answers. Expect the first pass from us by Tue 2026-10-19. If you can include a short section in the questionnaire about "update / patch workflow for air-gapped instances" that would be helpful.

—Alice
Alice Zhu
Head of InfoSec, MedForge Health
alice.zhu@medforge.com

Alice — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached are the questionnaire and a fillable network-boundary template (same files referenced earlier). A few notes that map to your asks: 

- Questionnaire highlights: we added a dedicated "Air-gapped deployment" section per your request covering patch cadence, signed artifacts, offline model updates, and validation checks. Expect about 20–30 fields for the initial pass.
- Network template: simple swimlanes for "Customer VPC / On-prem", "Redwood Private Gateway", and "Control plane (out-of-band)" — please sketch NAT/firewall policies and any site-local load balancer. SVG is easiest to drop into your internal diagrams.
- SOC / auditor contact: you can share the scoping doc to security@redwoodinference.com and I’ll route to our Trust team. If there are specific control numbers you want us to map to SOC 2 AICPA categories, flag them in the questionnaire.

Questions for you to confirm in the initial pass:
- Data residency: will EU-in-scope data remain in EU regions or will it traverse US infra?
- Tokenization: are you expecting Redwood to perform tokenization/Pseudonymization at inference time or will MedForge send already-pseudonymized payloads?
- KMS: do you require a customer-managed KMS key (we support external key wrap via AWS KMS and HSM integrations)?

Next steps: we’ll await your returned spreadsheet + diagram. Once received our security team (cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com) will do a first-pass compliance review and then propose follow-up windows.

Thanks —

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
